scripts.keys:grind-devnet: node scripts/grind-program-keypair.mjs ifx keys/devnet-program-keypair.json --exact && node scripts/write-devnet-program-id.mjs
scripts.security:preflight: npm run keys:sync && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo build-sbf -- -p ifx && npm run keys:verify && npm run security-txt:check
scripts.idl:generate: npm run keys:sync && anchor build && cp target/idl/ifx.json idl/ifx.json
scripts.idl:sync: mkdir -p target/idl target/types && cp idl/ifx.json target/idl/ifx.json && cp idl/ifx.json sdk/src/idl/ifx.json && anchor idl type idl/ifx.json -o target/types/ifx.ts && anchor idl type idl/ifx.json -o sdk/src/idl/ifx.ts
scripts.pretest: npm run keys:sync && npm run keys:verify && npm run idl:sync && anchor build --no-idl && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$PWD/target cargo build-sbf -- -p ifx && cd sdk && npm run build && cd .. && npm run examples:typecheck
scripts.sdk:pack: npm run idl:sync && cd sdk && npm run rebuild && npm pack
scripts.sdk:publish: npm run idl:sync && cd sdk && npm publish
scripts.all:test: npm test && npm run go:test && npm run rust:test
scripts.rust:test: cargo test -p ifx-sdk && cargo test -p ifx-core --doc
